purpose: Clip 03 beat 1/3 (Kling v3 Standard, first/last frame): one local physical task between cp02_still and cp03a_still. The three beats are hard-cut together in the edit, which may trim or speed-ramp each one.

stills.source: manual ChatGPT, approved in the stills folder

model.prompt: Vertical 9:16 realistic documentary footage, one continuous 3-second shot. Locked high camera looking down the length of the rusted red-brown railcar - no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. It starts exactly on the first image and ends exactly on the last image. Same railcar, open end door, tracks, pine forest, mist and overcast light throughout; the same bearded builder in a black beanie, dark charcoal hoodie, tan canvas work pants and work gloves. One local task: he starts clearing the ground at the car's near-left corner. He sets the measuring pole and clipboard inside the open end door, wheels the wheelbarrow in from the bottom edge of frame, and shovels weeds and brush along the window side toward the third window - scoop, lift, dump into the barrow - tipping one load onto a new small heap at the lower-left edge. He ends at the third window, blade in the weeds for the next scoop. Every patch of bare earth appears only where his shovel has just dug; each scoop is lifted and dumped into the wheelbarrow, and brush lands on the heap only when he tips it there. Nothing morphs, no debris vanishes or appears on its own, no new objects.

extra_params.negative_prompt: morphing, debris vanishing or appearing on its own, objects popping in or out, teleporting tools or wheelbarrow, camera movement, zoom, pan, dissolve, crossfade, different person, different railcar, on-screen text, blur, distort, low quality
